info.title: Tented API
info.description:
The Tented public API: generate, publish, and manage AI-built web pages (tents), and run the email platform — contacts, reusable emails, one-time blasts, and triggered flows.

## Authentication
Authenticate every request with a workspace API key: `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`. Keys are created in **Workspace Settings → API Keys** and are scoped to a single workspace.

## Asynchronous work
Tent generation, bulk creation, and email AI generation return `202 Accepted` immediately. Poll the corresponding status endpoint (`GET /v1/tents/{tentId}`, `GET /v1/bulk-jobs/{bulkJobId}`, `GET /v1/emails/{emailId}/generations/{generationId}`) — no more than every 10 seconds.

## Pagination
Email listings use cursor pagination (`cursor`/`next_cursor`). Blast, flow, and member listings use page pagination (`page`/`limit` with a `pagination` object in the response).

## Conventions
Request and response fields are snake_case, with two exceptions: analytics query parameters (`tentIdOrAlias`, `daysBack`) and segment rule trees (camelCase keys such as `listId` and `timeWindow`).

post.description: Create a tent and queue its first generation from a prompt, an approved template, or both. Generation is asynchronous: poll `GET /v1/tents/{tentId}` for progress. Creating from a template without a prompt copies the template synchronously and returns `201`.

user_id.description: External identifier recorded as the creator of the generation. Does not affect authentication or scope.

include_brand.description: Pull workspace brand context (logo, colors, company info, brand guidelines) into the generation.

template_id.description: Create from an approved template in the same workspace.

auto_publish.description: Publish automatically after a successful generation.

custom_page_alias.description: Custom published alias: max 100 characters; lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, and dots; must start with a letter or number; must not be a UUID or a reserved word (`api`, `admin`, `submit`, `assets`, …). Use `/` to publish at the domain root. Requires `auto_publish: true`.

token_data.description: Structured personalization data made available to the generation as tokens.

tent_id.description: Generate into an existing idle tent — use this after uploading assets to `/v1/tents/new/assets`.

asset_ids.description: Up to 5 uploaded asset IDs to reference. Requires `tent_id`.

post.description: Upload one file (max 4 MB) to a tent as `multipart/form-data` with a single `file` field. Pass the literal tent ID `new` to create an idle tent and get back its `actual_tent_id` for use with `POST /v1/tents`. Supported types: images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, SVG, WebP, ICO, TIFF, AVIF), documents (PDF, Word, Markdown, plain text, Excel, CSV, PowerPoint), and media (MP4, WebM, QuickTime, MP3, WAV).

bearerAuth.description: Workspace API key, e.g. `Authorization: Bearer tented_...`. Create keys in Workspace Settings → API Keys.

error_code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (present on email, blast, flow, and related endpoints, e.g. `campaign_not_ready`, `generation_in_progress`).

message.description: Additional human-readable context (present on some tent endpoints).

code.description: Machine-readable code used by tent creation errors (e.g. `INVALID_PROMPT_INTENT`).

details.description: Additional error context. Validation errors include `issues`: an array of `{ path, message }` objects.

limit.description: Plan limit that was hit (present on `429` publish-limit errors).

current.description: Current usage against the limit (present on `429` publish-limit errors).

published_url.description: Public URL of the published page.

requested_custom_page_alias.description: Alias requested in the API call, or `null`.

applied_custom_page_alias.description: Alias actually applied. `null` when the alias could not be applied (see `warnings`).

Publication.description: Publication state for a tent generation.

error.description: Failure reason. Present only when `status` is `failed`.

TentStatus.description: Tent generation status. Poll no more than every 10 seconds; the response sets `Retry-After: 10` while work is in progress.

actual_tent_id.description: Tent the asset was attached to. When you upload to `/v1/tents/new/assets`, this is the newly created idle tent — pass it as `tent_id` to `POST /v1/tents`.

asset_id.description: Asset ID. Reference it in `asset_ids` when creating or editing the tent.

content_type.description: MIME type of the uploaded file.

pending_reconciliation.description: Credits still reserved for unfinished items.

index.description: Zero-based position of the item in the original request.

client_item_id.description: Your reconciliation ID, echoed back when supplied.

tent_id.description: Tent created for this item (accepted items only).

custom_page_alias.description: Requested alias, echoed back when supplied.

status.description: Job state. `completed_with_failures` means at least one item failed after admission.

auto_publish.description: Whether the batch publishes tents automatically.

tent_id.description: Tent ID, or the literal `org` for workspace-level analytics.

visits.description: Unique visits in the date range.

pageviews.description: Total pageviews in the date range.

path.description: Page path. Only present on workspace-level analytics.

email_domain.description: Domain derived from the email address.

original_source.description: How the contact was first created, e.g. `Public API`.

marketing_email_invalid.description: Whether the email address is known to be invalid.

marketing_sms_invalid.description: Whether the phone number is known to be invalid.

ready.description: Whether the blast can be scheduled or sent.

operator.description: Comparison operator. Strings: `equals`, `not_equals`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `starts_with`, `ends_with`. Membership: `is_member`, `is_not_member`. Activity: `has_activity`, `has_no_activity`. Shorthand aliases (`eq`, `neq`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `member_of`) are accepted.
